certification.name: PECB Certificate Holder in ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation
certification.description: Foundation certificate on the elements of an information security management system under ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Awarded after passing the PECB ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation exam; no prior experience is required.
certification.currency_note: Exam and certification fees are included in the price of the PECB training course; no standalone list price published
